# platform.FeatureFlag

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A feature flag with its effective value and expiry status.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `platform.FeatureFlag` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `none` |
| Tenancy scope | `platform` |
| Permission | `core.flag.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `createdAt` | yes | `none` | When the flag was introduced (UTC). |  |
| `default` | yes | `none` | Value when no environment or tenant value is set. |  |
| `expired` | yes | `none` | True once expiresAt has passed; shown as a warning. |  |
| `expiresAt` | yes | `none` | When the flag must be removed or renewed (UTC); after createdAt. |  |
| `key` | yes | `none` | Flag key. |  |
| `kind` | yes | `none` | `kill-switch`, `rollout` or `ops`. |  |
| `owner` | yes | `none` | Team or role that owns the flag (governance). |  |
| `reason` | yes | `none` | Why the flag exists. |  |
| `tenantOverride` | yes | `none` | Tenant override, null when none. |  |
| `value` | yes | `none` | Effective value in this environment (and tenant, when asked). |  |
